name: mcp
description: Bridge external MCP servers' tools into the catalog as ordinary operations — curated one-by-one or mirrored wholesale. Load to connect outside tool servers.

content.inline:
## MCP bridging
Bridged tools become ordinary catalog operations: capability checks, job records and schema validation still apply. The operation is the durable entity; the server is its execution endpoint.

- Curate one remote tool with `{server, tool, path, auth?, name?, description?, default?}`. default pre-fills arguments to expose a smaller, purpose-shaped contract. Delete the curated path to remove it.
- Mirror a server with `{name, url, auth?, scope?}` under `o/mcp/<name>/`; venue scope requires mcp/manage. The corresponding removal operation deletes a mirror.
- Refresh by `{name}` to reconcile a mirror or `{path}` to update a curated operation. Preview definitions with `{server, auth?}` before bridging.

Rules:
- auth must be `s/<name>`; never store raw tokens in bridge metadata.
- Server URLs pass the venue's SSRF and allowlist policy.
- Creating a catalog operation does not automatically add its schema to the current provider call. Load a skill that contributes the bridged operation, acquire the known operation dynamically when the runtime offers that control, or invoke it through an advertised dispatcher. Select the resulting callable from the current palette; never rely on a name copied from durable prose.
